page.layout: One page of text, single column, no margin notes. Running head at top with page number at top left. Headings are centred small-capital lines, each followed by a decorative ornament and then a paragraph of Latin verses.

main_text.head: LONE, vel NELO.
main_text.p: Illum nobis: Lo ne, vel ne lo tólse, & Tólselo-ne, vel Tólsenelo, illum nobis abstulit. Illum hinc, illinc, istinc, lo ne, ne lo menò, &, Menóllone, vel Menónnelo, illum hinc, illinc, istinc abduxit.
main_text.head: LAMI, vel MELA
main_text.p: Illam mihi, la mi, vel me la raccomandásti; &, Raccomandástilami, vel Raccomandá-stimela, Illam mihi commendasti.
main_text.head: LATI, vel TELA
main_text.p: Illam tibi, La ti, vel te la raccomandáì, &, Raccomandáitati, vel Raccomandáitela, Illam tibi commendaui.
main_text.head: LASI, SE LA.
main_text.p: Illā sibi, La si, Se la prése, & Préselasi, vel Présela per móglie, illam sibi vxorem duxit.
main_text.head: LACI, vel CELA
main_text.p: Illam nob. La ci, vel Ce la raccomandò, & Raccomandóllaci, vel Raccomandóccela, illam nobis commendauit.
